parsed.explanation: No trans criminalisation, no police targeting, no facility bans, no universal-exposure measure; foreign documents are the operative papers and nothing documented friction at the border. Official climate is comparatively positive (Pride endorsements, 2024 decrees naming trans people, non-discriminatory health policy). Counting against: documented societal hostility toward trans people (family/community abuse, bullying, verbal abuse in some public services including medical care) with thin remedy — hate-crime and non-discrimination law cover sexual orientation only, no general equality law, and no sourced enforcement in a trans case. The severe violence record is local-sphere (family, school) and a small self-selected sample, not traveller-facing. Border and custody practice are open questions, not exposures. Net: acceptance-with-gaps plus incomplete GI-specific recourse — reduced but not low risk.
